title: AI gets maths wrong. So I gave it a calculator.
hook: Stop asking AI to remember facts. Give it something to look them up in.
summary: Stop asking AI to remember facts. Give it something to look them up in.
body: Ask a chatbot whether your Pokémon survives a hit and it answers straight away, dead certain. Often it's wrong. It never sounds wrong, which is the bit that catches you.
People say AI is too unreliable for real work. On its own, fair enough. Plugged into a real tool, it's a different thing, and hardly anyone plugs it in.
